When their search for a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] spy lead them to [[Mon Gazza/Legends|Mon Gazza]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] purchased a '''used Podracer''' for his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] to used during the [[Mon Gazza Speedway/Legends|Mon Gazza Speedway]]. It was destroyed during a qualifying lap by [[Raido]]. She did end up qualifying for the race, anyway, and fellow racer [[Kidd Kareen]] lent her a [[TurboDyne 99]]. The Podracer was painted [[Color/Legends|green]] and featured cooling radiators.
